fusions.name: Bow Wave
fusions.desc: Pushes a wave out from you that deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, throws each back 3 tiles and leaves it [Soaked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Unhurried Swell
fusions.desc: Sends a swell of water into the first enemy it meets, where it deals 28 damage. It ignores the target's resistances.

fusions.name: Shrugged Off
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you, and you regain 10 health.

fusions.name: Unruffled
fusions.desc: The moment you are back at full health, your physical damage rises by 25% for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
